# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 37 tokens; Text — 11 tokens; Borders and rings — 4 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 122 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 33 tokens; Radius — 11 tokens; Shadow — 3 tokens; Opacity — 6 tokens.

## Color · Text


### Tokens (11)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text-dark` | #111111 | #111111 | Always-dark text, regardless of theme (e.g. on a fixed light chip). |

| `text-error` | #cc0000 | #f47171 | Error-state text and validation messages. |

| `text-subtle` | #767676 | #a5a5a5 | Secondary / de-emphasized text on `surface`. |
| `text-success` | #005f3e | #39d377 | Success-state text (confirmations, positive status). |

## Type

Use the named styles; no literal px.

### Use

```css
font: var(--text-help-text);            /* with tokens.css */
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `help-text` | `.help-text`, `--text-help-text` | 12px / 1.4 | 400 | `sans` | Help text — form fields, metadata, secondary info. (source size token 100) |
| `body-dense` | `.body-dense`, `--text-body-dense` | 14px / 1.4 | 400 | `sans` | Body, dense — tables, internal tools, and body copy for dense business interfaces. (source size token 200) |
| `body-default` | `.body-default`, `--text-body-default` | 16px / 1.4 | 400 | `sans` | Body, default — default body copy for multi-line, paragraph text. (source size token 300) |
| `heading-sm` | `.heading-sm`, `--text-heading-sm` | 20px / 1.4 | 600 | `sans` | Heading, sm — small headings, usually an H3. (source size token 400) |
| `heading-md` | `.heading-md`, `--text-heading-md` | 28px / 1.4 | 600 | `sans` | Heading, md — PageHeaders, medium headlines. (source size token 500) |
| `heading-lg` | `.heading-lg`, `--text-heading-lg` | 36px / 1.4 | 600 | `sans` | Heading, lg — large headlines, usually an H1. (source size token 600) |
| `code` | `.code`, `--text-code` | 14px / 1.4 | 400 | `mono` | Inline code and monospace content. |
| `brand-display` | `.brand-display`, `--text-brand-display` | 36px / 1.4 | 700 | `brand` | Pinterest Sans — branded/marketing graphics ONLY. Never used in product UI (product UI always uses the Text group's system-font styles). |

## Shadow

Gestalt's dark theme intentionally drops elevation shadows in favor of flat surface-color layering (see background-elevation-* tokens) — the dark values below are the source's actual (near-zero-opacity) values, kept exact rather than approximated.

### Use

```css
/* var(--shadow-floating) */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `shadow-floating` | 0px 0px 8px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) · dark: none |  |
| `shadow-raised-bottom` | 0px -2px 8px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12) · dark: 0px -0.5px 0px 0px rgba(249, 249, 249, 0) |  |
| `shadow-raised-top` | 0px 2px 8px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12) · dark: 0px 0.5px 0px 0px rgba(249, 249, 249, 0) |  |
